intended_object: This is an internal piece of the library's SAT-to-GapCVP hardness reduction. It is the matrix, over the finite field K, of the linear map that checks one SAT constraint family on the encoded table. I inferred this from the docstring, the name and how the library uses it.
explanation: The definition just applies `LinearMap.toMatrix'` to `sourceSATFamilyLinearMap`, a gadget specific to this library's reduction. Its row and column counts come from bookkeeping functions of the same construction (`sourceSATFamilyRowCount`, `sourceSATTableDimension`). It is only used to assemble the reduction's matrices and in a lemma that rewrites `mulVec` back to the linear map. It is a step in a proof, and the literature has no standard object it corresponds to.
